# Reducing training content costs

Learning & Development (L&D) administrators face multiple challenges in managing the training and skilling programs in their organisation. These include identifying and analysing relevant content amidst an abundance of resources, tacit knowledge management, vendor and Subject Matter Expert dependence for content updates as well as managing administrative overhead.

**Disprz solved this by using Generative AI to create engagement and Azure OpenAI to drive personalisation.**

![Disprz logo](https://cdn-dynmedia-1.microsoft.com/is/image/microsoftcorp/disprz1-1?scl=1&fmt=png-alpha)

## Creating engaging content

Disprz is creating a Generative AI (Gen AI) based content creation and transformation engine for L&D administrators. This will enable them to create engaging training content for easy consumption. Learning materials can also be created either on their own or by leveraging internal employee expertise or by simply performing administrative tasks through a conversational platform.

In addition, Disprz is also solving for a high degree of personalisation and accessibility of learning materials by using Advanced Learning

Models from Azure OpenAI.

Gen AI-based content creation and transformation engines have a potential to reduce content creation or purchase cost by over 25% in the short run and over 50% in the long run. It will also greatly drive learning adoption and outcomes through engaging content formats.
